title: Legacy Boat Ruins
description: Boat Ruins Mod — three shipwreck variants spawn in ocean biomes with five loot tables. Cartographers sell maps to the   nearest ruin.
body:
Boat Ruins Mod

Sunken wrecks, buried treasure, and ocean mysteries waiting to be found.

What It Does

Three shipwreck variants spawn across all ocean biomes, each carrying five possible chest loot tables — from common sailor junk to rare deep-sea riches. Cartographer villagers sell explorer maps that lead straight to the nearest ruin.

Features

3 structure variants randomly selected from a weighted template pool
5 custom loot tables with carefully tuned drop rates
Cartographer explorer map trade at level 3
Fully data-driven — all JSON configs follow vanilla conventions, easy to tweak or extend

Commands

/locate structure boat_ruins_mod:legacy_boat_ruins

/setblock ~ ~ ~ minecraft:chest{LootTable:"boat_ruins_mod:chests/treasure"}

Requirements

┌───────────────┬──────────────┐ │ Component │ Version │ ├───────────────┼──────────────┤ │ Minecraft │ 26.2 │ ├───────────────┼──────────────┤ │ Fabric Loader │ 0.19.3+ │ ├───────────────┼──────────────┤ │ Fabric API │ 0.152.1+26.2 │ └───────────────┴──────────────┘

Installation

Drop boat_ruins_mod-1.0.0.jar into your mods folder.

License

CC0 — use it, remix it, ship it in your modpack.
